description: The provided image is a 100% stacked bar chart illustrating the proportion of "Targets (conceptualized or operationalized) over time." The horizontal category axis is labeled "Year" and displays discrete years in chronological order from 2012 to 2022, with the labels rotated vertically. The vertical value axis lacks an explicit title but represents proportions on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, featuring numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 0.2 and corresponding dashed horizontal grid lines. The chart uses stacked bars to show the relative composition of target quantities for each year, with the components defined in a legend titled "Targets." The legend maps colors to numerical categories: "0" (blue), "1" (orange), "2-4" (green), "5-7" (red), and "8+" (purple). Within each bar, the segments are stacked from bottom to top in this sequence, starting with blue at the base. The composition of the bars varies notably across the timeline; for example, the 2012 bar is composed entirely of the green "2-4" category (1.0), and the 2013 bar consists entirely of the blue "0" category (1.0). In contrast, the 2019 bar includes all five categories, with approximate values of 0.2 for blue, 0.2 for orange, 0.22 for green, 0.33 for red, and 0.05 for purple. The blue "0" category forms the base of the stacks for all years from 2013 to 2022, ranging from its peak of 1.0 in 2013 to a minimum of roughly 0.2 in 2019. The bars are sorted chronologically from left to right. Visually, the bar representing the year 2022 is emphasized by being rendered in faded, translucent pastel shades of the standard blue, orange, green, and red colors, distinguishing it from the solid, opaque colors used for the years 2012 through 2021.
